name: fine-print
description: Free Chrome extension that reads Terms of Service and privacy policies, sums up the worst part in one sentence, and shows you where it says so.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build -c vite.background.config.ts && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
scripts.dev: vite build --watch & vite build -c vite.background.config.ts --watch & vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch
scripts.test:serve: npm run build && vite build -c vite.harness.config.ts && node test/serve.mjs
